faq.q: Why is the Wave Manager missing after buying the Bicycle?
faq.a: Defeat the wave-100 boss on that map first. On a cleared map, look at the lower left beside your team.

faq.q: How do I move my PokéPath TD save to another device?
faq.a: Open Settings → Data → Export data → Download on the device that has the progress, then use Import data → Upload .txt → Load save on the new one. Keep the source device until the team and route progress are visible.

faq.q: Does PokéPath TD work on a phone?
faq.a: The original FAQ calls mobile support limited and recommends PC. It reports Android working fairly well and Safari failing to load on iOS. Phone performance depends on the browser and device.

faq.q: Which Pokémon helps against armored enemies?
faq.a: Excadrill is the armor pick in the original Pokédex: Armor Break doubles damage to armored enemies, and it can use field and mountain tiles.

faq.q: Why does my team lose to Lunala on Route 1-3?
faq.a: Check invisibility coverage before adding damage. Lunala regains invisibility and its shield four seconds after losing invisibility, and it resists Stun and Poison.

faq.q: Where do I enter a PokéPath TD code?
faq.a: Open Menu → Data, paste the string into Paste redeem code and choose Redeem. The original unlock guide lists BOOPKABOO; confirm current redemption in the game.

faq.q: Is PokéPath TD the same game as PokeBonk or PokéRogue?
faq.a: No. PokéPath is a route tower defense game with its own progression. PokeBonk, PokéSurvivor, PokéRogue and PokéClicker are separate projects.
